prompt:

Deliver one full-resolution square image with the SAME original composition and background.

Preserve every original feature and only add these accessories.

visualInspectionNotes: Original A1-v2 pose, size, crop and background appear retained. Keyboard overlaps a small lower-left cream cheek edge and extends into left/bottom canvas edges despite requested accessory clearance.
